```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# PURE GRAPH V3: DEPARTMENTS + PRICE
# no time features

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    price >= 0
  )

# BASIC BASKET PROFILE

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id")

# DEPARTMENT RARITY

dept_freq_tbl <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(department, name = "dept_freq") %>%
  mutate(
    dept_commonness = dept_freq / max(dept_freq),
    dept_rarity = 1 - dept_commonness
  )

dept_rarity_lookup <- dept_freq_tbl$dept_rarity
names(dept_rarity_lookup) <- dept_freq_tbl$department


# EDGE SURPRISE

basket_depts <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

edge_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(basket_depts$departments, function(depts) {
  if (length(depts) < 2) {
    return(tibble(dept_a = integer(), dept_b = integer()))
  }
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  tibble(
    dept_a = pairs[, 1],
    dept_b = pairs[, 2]
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_a, dept_b, name = "edge_n") %>%
  mutate(
    edge_commonness = edge_n / max(edge_n),
    edge_surprise = 1 - edge_commonness
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_key = paste(dept_a, dept_b, sep = "_")
  )

edge_surprise_lookup <- edge_counts$edge_surprise
names(edge_surprise_lookup) <- edge_counts$edge_key

strong_edge_threshold <- quantile(edge_counts$edge_commonness, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

get_edge_keys <- function(depts) {
  depts <- sort(unique(depts))
  if (length(depts) < 2) return(character(0))
  pairs <- t(combn(depts, 2))
  paste(pairs[, 1], pairs[, 2], sep = "_")
}

calc_entropy_norm <- function(counts_vec) {
  probs <- counts_vec / sum(counts_vec)
  ent <- -sum(probs * log(probs))
  if (length(probs) <= 1) return(0)
  ent / log(length(probs))
}

# PRICE-AWARE ITEM LAYER

long_graph <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    dept_freq_tbl %>% select(department, dept_rarity),
    by = "department"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dept_rarity = replace_na(dept_rarity, 0)
  )

price_model <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(price_model, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

# GRAPH + PRICE FEATURES PER BASKET

graph_price_features <- long_graph %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    departments = list(sort(unique(department))),
    dept_item_counts = list(table(department)),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_dept_rarity = mean(dept_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_dept_rarity = max(dept_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_rarity_value_share = sum(
      ifelse(dept_rarity >= quantile(dept_freq_tbl$dept_rarity, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), price, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    edge_keys = list(get_edge_keys(departments)),
    mean_edge_surprise = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      mean(edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    ),
    max_edge_surprise = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      max(edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    ),
    graph_entropy = calc_entropy_norm(as.numeric(dept_item_counts)),
    density_surprise = ifelse(
      length(edge_keys) > 0,
      1 - mean((1 - edge_surprise_lookup[edge_keys]) >= strong_edge_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    high_rarity_value_share = replace_na(high_rarity_value_share, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    avg_dept_rarity,
    max_dept_rarity,
    high_rarity_value_share,
    mean_edge_surprise,
    max_edge_surprise,
    graph_entropy,
    density_surprise
  )

# FINAL GRAPH V3 SCORE

basket_graph_v3 <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(graph_price_features, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    graph_v3_score =
      0.15 * percent_rank(avg_dept_rarity) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_dept_rarity) +
      0.20 * percent_rank(mean_edge_surprise) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(max_edge_surprise) +
      0.20 * percent_rank(high_rarity_value_share) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(graph_entropy) +
      0.10 * percent_rank(density_surprise) +
      0.05 * percent_rank(price_deviation)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(graph_v3_score))

top_150_graph_v3_train <- basket_graph_v3 %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$avg_price)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$avg_dept_rarity)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$mean_edge_surprise)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$high_rarity_value_share)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$graph_entropy)
summary(top_150_graph_v3_train$graph_v3_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_graph_v3_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_graph_v3_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
